entries.title: Isaiah 44:1
segments:
vv 1-5. 
 
The promised outpouring of God's life-giving Spirit is the hope of Zion.  In times of deep declension within her borders, and abounding wickedness without, God's faithful servants should not despond, but seek from him this unspeakable gift by repentance, obedience, and earnest intercession, assured that when he bestows it all will again become green and flourishing.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:2
segments: Jeshurun; a term of endearment applied ot Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:7
segments:
Call; command into being. 
 
  Declare it; announce it beforehand. 
 
  Set it in order for me; that is, as the original implies, state it to me in regular order.  Jehovah both ordains and foretells the course of coming events for his people; he challenges the false gods to do the same. 
 
  The ancient people; either the ancestors of the human race or those of the Israelitish people.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:8
segments:
Fear ye not; the idol-gods, which have no power either to do or to foretell. 
 
  From that time; that is, "since I appointed the ancient people."
Told--declared; the course of coming events.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:9
segments:
Delectable things; idols in which they delight. 
 
vv 9-20. 
 
The idolater fashions silver or wood into the form of a god and then worships it, as if human workmanship could give life to that which is in its own nature dead and powerless.  The same folly is manifested by all who think to make worldly objects a permanent and satisfying portion by any labor which they can bestow upon them.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:14
segments: Strengtheneth for himself; has nourished by culture.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:18
segments: He hath shut their eyes; God hath shut them.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:20
segments:
Deliver his soul; from its delusion. 
 
  Nor say; he has not understanding enough to ask himself the question that follows. 
 
  In my right hand; the right hand is mentioned as the instrument of action: to have a lie in the right hand, is to be occupied with a lie; that is, with the service of idols, which are themselves false, and which deceive those who put their trust in them.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:21
segments: These; these proofs of the vanity of idols.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:22
segments: It is by the offer of gratuitous pardon that God calls sinners to himself.  He commands them to come, that they may receive through Christ the justifying righteousness which he has provided for them; not to establish their own righteousness before coming to him.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:23
segments: Christ's redemption is the sum of all blessings.  It fills every heart that receives it with gladness and thanksgiving.  When all nations shall embrace it, the whole erth will resound with God's praises.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:24
segments: Formed thee from the womb; Israel is here spoken of as God's child from the womb, that is, from the infancy of the nation.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:25
segments:
Tokens; signs, pretended miracles. 
 
  Maketh diviners mad; shows them to be fools. 
 
The progress of God's kingdom in the world is a perpetual manifestation of his own infinite power and wisdom, and of the folly and weakness of all human systems of religion.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:26
segments: His servant; the prophet with his fellow-messengers.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:28
segments: Cyrus; who conquered Babylon, and released the Jews from their exile more than a century and a half after this prediction. Ezr 1.1-4
